entries.09b43ef2cc1426ba: Under the Fifth Medium-Term Management Plan, which started in the fiscal year ended November 2023, the company has focused on the following priority strategies: “Service and business development and transformation of business models in the Life Creative Business Unit”; “Enhancing brand value through ‘customer experience’ that exceeds expectations”; “Business creation through ‘co-creation’ inside and outside the group”; “Improving earnings power in existing business areas”; and “Transforming the organizational culture into one where people who ‘think and act for themselves’ gather.” In the fiscal year ended November 2025, the final year of the plan, the company pursued the creation of new value through collaboration and co-creation inside and outside the group and active growth investment, and implemented measures aimed at growth in housing and living business areas, starting with the renovation business. The numerical targets of the medium-term management plan are not stated in the main text.
